title: Walk in Love and Forgiveness
opening: Forgiveness is part of Christian discipleship, but it does not mean excusing wrongdoing or removing the need for safety, justice, and healthy boundaries.
points: Remember the mercy you have received and choose not to nurture revenge.
Speak honestly about harm and seek wise help when reconciliation is difficult.
Practise compassion while keeping appropriate boundaries where needed.
reflection: What would a wise, loving response look like in a difficult relationship?
prayer: Jesus, teach me compassion and forgiveness. Give me wisdom to pursue peace, truth, and healthy boundaries. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
